geometryBasis: The eight vertices of OpenStreetMap cathedral way 110346974 fix the España Street front and the broad building envelope. The national heritage description identifies the Latin-cross arrangement, three naves, transept and deep presbytery.
sectionBasis: The exact public-domain Qualla view establishes the projecting triple arcade, cream Corinthian columns, pink planes, lobed blue window and two levels of open belfries. Argentina’s heritage inventory documents the crossing drum, dome and lantern. Off-camera roof profiles, elevations and details are estimates.
